name: Hyundai Home Shopping Network Corporation
summary: Hyundai Home Shopping Network Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an online shopping company in South Korea. The company offers fashion clothing/underwear; luxury goods/accessories; beauty products, including skincare, body care, perfume, hair care, make up, and other products; fresh/processed food; health food; living/kitchen/health; furniture/bedding/home; childbirth/infant; home appliances/digital; sports/leisure/care; travel/tickets/rentals/insurance; and hobbies/culture/companion products. It is also involved in the manufacturing and sale of building materials, such as flooring products, as well as cosmetics and pharmaceutical raw materials; digital solution business; and wholesale and retail of clothing. Hyundai Home Shopping Network Corporation was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Hyundai Home Shopping Network Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Hyundai G.F. Holdings Co., Ltd.
